# ghost/coin-flip

Flip a coin (F-Droid): flip a coin once or many times and read head or tail. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/coin-flip
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/coin-flip open_coin --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/coin-flip flip --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/coin-flip flip_many --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/coin-flip get_result --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_coin`: Open the coin flip app
- `flip`: Flip a coin for me please
- `flip_many`: Flip a coin five times
- `get_result`: What does the coin show?
